subject: Seize a spot in a queue(not necessarily server capacity)

messages.author: 166a0f8fb42e5018
messages.subject: Seize a spot in a queue(not necessarily server capacity)
parts:
Hello, 

I am working through a trajectory that has arrivals flow sequentially through a path of resources each with individual capacity and queue limits. I want to ensure that an arrival does not release a resource until it can get a spot in queue or server at the next one. I am using a rollback as detailed in some vignettes to keep the arrival from being rejected when the queue is full . Then the next step in the trajectory after the seize is the release of the 1st resource. I noticed that the log of the arrivals by resource records the 1st resource to be finished only once the arrival gets out of the queue at the second resource. This implies that the arrival is taking up capacity both in the queue at the second resource as well as in the server at the 1st. I would like the arrival to release capacity at the 1st as soon as it can get a spot in the queue at the next resource.  

Will a seize only be successful if there is capacity available in the server and not just the queue? 
Is there some argument or functionality I can use to get around that? 

Thanks in advance for your help!
